title: Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt
function: Disc brake rotor mounting bolt, M6x12mm T25 Torx
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Disc brake rotor mounting bolt, M6x12mm T25 Torx. This rationale is driven by disc brake rotor mounting bolt, m6x12mm t25 torx and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for brake rotor hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with 0.5mm corner radius
Go/No-Go ring gauging with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for disc brake rotor application
commonFailures: Fatigue failure at head tube junction - mitigated by smooth weld radius >=5mm + post-weld shot peening — critical for disc brake rotor performance

faq.q: What surface finishes are compatible with Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt for cycling use?
faq.a: Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt can be supplied with bead-blasted matte (Ra 1.6-3.2 µm), brushed satin, mirror polish, or PVD-colored finish. Bead-blasted + passivation is the standard for disc brake rotor as it provides the best balance of cosmetic consistency, corrosion resistance, and cost. Anodized colors (gold, blue, purple per ASTM B136) are available on request.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Disc Brake Rotor Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for disc brake rotor.
